result.title: Value-Conditioned Proposal Acquisition for Test-Time Reasoning
result.summary: Sampling and selection spend test-time compute inside a candidate pool, but they cannot recover a correct answer that never enters it. We introduce ValueFormation, a test-time policy that decides after each primary-model draw whether to stop, continue sampling, or acquire one proposal from a heterogeneous reasoning specialist. The three actions are compared on one cost-regularized value scale learned from vote-state features; the calibration is frozen across tasks and primary models, and acquired proposals are accepted only through a frozen posterior comparison. On held-out MATH-500, one Llama-fitted calibration improves over the strongest of eight identically evaluated baselines by more than fifteen points for each of three 8B primaries and transfers unchanged to Qwen3-14B. Removing acquisition lowers Llama MATH accuracy by 20.43 points, while same-trace and same-access replays attribute the gain to state-conditioned acquisition rather than specialist access alone. Where primary coverage is high, as on GSM8K, acquisition is rare and gains mainly come from cheaper allocation; on MBPP, a fixed code route attains the top accuracy at the lowest interaction cost. Varying the token price monotonically reduces calls without retraining.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ValueFormation：每次主模型采样后，依据投票状态特征在统一的成本正则价值尺度上比较「停止、继续采样、向异构推理专家索取一个提案」三种动作，并以冻结的校准与后验比较决定采纳，在 MATH-500、GSM8K、MBPP 上检验准确率与交互成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其停止/继续/获取外部提案的统一价值校准与 token 价格敏感性，可供核查 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的收益与成本归因及校准跨模型迁移；但该工作为纯文本推理控制，未涉及视觉状态表示，迁移需再评估。
